description.p: Chatte is a pure native GNOME 50 desktop application built with GTK 4 and Libadwaita that connects directly to OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and llama.cpp endpoints without any intermediary proxies or WebViews.

ul.li: Direct provider connections with API keys stored securely in GNOME Keyring
Real-time token counting, sliding context windows, prompt caching, and idle local model auto-unloading
On-demand Markdown Skills, Structured Prompts, and Function Calling from the chatbox '+' menu
Built-in DuckDuckGo and Wikipedia Web Search with interactive inline citations
100% native Markdown, GtkSourceView 5 syntax highlighting, and PangoCairo LaTeX math rendering
Strictly local SQLite storage with automatic message edit branching and conversation forking
